description: This file contains Redux selectors for managing and retrieving channel-related data in a Mattermost application, including functions for accessing channels, memberships, unread counts, permissions, and channel properties.

methods.name: getAllChannels
methods.description: Returns all channels from the global state.

methods.name: getAllDmChannels
methods.description: Selector that filters and returns all direct message channels.

methods.name: getAllChannelStats
methods.description: Returns statistics for all channels.

methods.name: getChannelsMemberCount
methods.description: Returns a record of channel IDs to member counts.

methods.name: getChannelsInTeam
methods.description: Returns channels grouped by team.

methods.name: getChannelsInPolicy
methods.description: Selector that filters channels based on a data retention policy.

methods.name: getDirectChannelsSet
methods.description: Selector that returns a set of direct channel IDs.

methods.name: getChannelMembersInChannels
methods.description: Returns a mapping of channel IDs to their members.

methods.name: getChannelMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific channel membership for a user.

methods.name: makeGetChannel
methods.description: Creates a selector to get a channel with additional info for DM/GM channels.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns a channel object by ID.

methods.name: getDirectChannel
methods.description: Returns a direct channel with additional info.

methods.name: getMyChannelMembership
methods.description: Returns the current user's membership for a channel.

methods.name: makeGetChannelsForIds
methods.description: Creates a selector to get multiple channels by IDs.

methods.name: getCurrentChannel
methods.description: Returns the current active channel with additional info.

methods.name: getChannelNameForSearchShortcut
methods.description: Returns the name of the current channel formatted for search.

methods.name: getCurrentChannelNameForSearchShortcut
methods.description: Returns the name of the current channel formatted for search.

methods.name: getChannelNameToDisplayNameMap
methods.description: Maps channel names to display names for the current team.

methods.name: getAllDirectChannels
methods.description: Returns all direct and group channels with user info.

methods.name: getAllDirectChannelsNameMapInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns a map of direct channel names to channels for current team.

methods.name: getGroupChannels
methods.description: Returns all group channels.

methods.name: getMyChannels
methods.description: Returns channels the user is a member of in the current team.

methods.name: getOtherChannels
methods.description: Returns channels in current team not joined by user.

methods.name: getMembersInCurrentChannel
methods.description: Returns members of the current channel.

methods.name: basicUnreadMeta
methods.description: Converts unread status to a meta object with isUnread and count.

methods.name: getUnreadStatus
methods.description: Calculates the unread status for channels.

methods.name: getTeamsUnreadStatuses
methods.description: Returns unread statuses for all teams.

methods.name: getUnreadStatusInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns unread status for the current team.

methods.name: canManageChannelMembers
methods.description: Determines if user can manage members in current channel.

methods.name: canManageAnyChannelMembersInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Checks if user can manage members in any channel of current team.

methods.name: getAllDirectChannelIds
methods.description: Returns all direct channel IDs.

methods.name: getChannelIdsInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns channel IDs in current team.

methods.name: getChannelIdsForCurrentTeam
methods.description: Returns all channel IDs for current team including direct channels.

methods.name: getChannelIdsInAllTeams
methods.description: Returns all channel IDs across all teams.

methods.name: getChannelIdsForAllTeams
methods.description: Returns all channel IDs across all teams including direct channels.

methods.name: getUnreadChannelIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of channels with unread messages.

methods.name: getAllTeamsUnreadChannelIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of unread channels across all teams.

methods.name: getUnreadChannels
methods.description: Returns unread channels with display info.

methods.name: getUnsortedAllTeamsUnreadChannels
methods.description: Returns unread channels unsorted.

methods.name: sortUnreadChannels
methods.description: Sorts channels by mentions, muted status, and recency.

methods.name: getSortedAllTeamsUnreadChannels
methods.description: Returns sorted unread channels across all teams.

methods.name: getDirectAndGroupChannels
methods.description: Returns all direct and group channels.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves user profiles for channels.

methods.name: getChannelsWithUserProfiles
methods.description: Returns channels with attached user profiles.

methods.name: getDefaultChannelForTeams
methods.description: Returns default channels for each team.

methods.name: getMyFirstChannelForTeams
methods.description: Returns first channel for each team the user is in.

methods.name: getRedirectChannelNameForCurrentTeam
methods.description: Gets redirect channel name for current team.

methods.name: getRedirectChannelNameForTeam
methods.description: Gets redirect channel name for specified team.

methods.name: isManuallyUnread
methods.description: Checks if a channel is manually marked as unread.

methods.name: getChannelModerations
methods.description: Returns moderation settings for a channel.

methods.name: getChannelMemberCountsByGroup
methods.description: Returns member counts grouped by group for a channel.

methods.name: isFavoriteChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is marked as favorite.

methods.name: filterChannelList
methods.description: Filters channels based on search options.

methods.name: searchChannelsInPolicy
methods.description: Searches channels within a policy with filters.

methods.name: getDirectTeammate
methods.description: Gets the other user in a direct message channel.

methods.name: makeGetGmChannelMemberCount
methods.description: Creates a selector for group channel member count.

methods.name: getMyActiveChannelIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of active channels.

methods.name: getRecentProfilesFromDMs
methods.description: Returns recent user profiles from DMs.

methods.name: isDeactivatedDirectChannel
methods.description: Checks if a direct channel is deactivated.

methods.name: getChannelBanner
methods.description: Returns banner info for a channel.

methods.name: isChannelAutotranslated
methods.description: Checks if a channel is autotranslated.

methods.name: isMyChannelAutotranslated
methods.description: Checks if current user sees autotranslation of a channel.

methods.name: isUserLanguageSupportedForAutotranslation
methods.description: Checks if user's language is supported for autotranslation.

methods.name: hasAutotranslationBecomeEnabled
methods.description: Determines if autotranslation has been enabled for a channel or member.
